jobs.title: Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
Verex Engineering LLC is a multi-cloud solutions and engineering company with expertise in healthcare and advanced cloud technologies. The organization helps clients manage applications and infrastructure across leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform in an integrated and secure manner. Verex Engineering LLC focuses on turning complex workload challenges into strategic business advantages, enabling clients to work faster and more efficiently. Its services span the full lifecycle of cloud projects, from consultation and assessment through deployment, migration, and ongoing management. The team follows industry best practices and uses modern tools to ensure seamless integration, security, and compliance across environments.
Role Description
The Environmental Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in San Francisco, CA. This position is responsible for assessing environmental impacts related to engineering and cloud infrastructure projects, including data centers and associated operations. Day-to-day tasks include performing environmental data collection and analysis, preparing reports and documentation, and supporting compliance with environmental regulations and internal policies. The Environmental Analyst collaborates with engineering, operations, and compliance teams to identify risks, recommend mitigation measures, and ensure sustainable practices across projects. The role also involves staying current with relevant environmental laws and standards and contributing to environmental management strategies that align with organizational and client objectives.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Environment Management skills, with experience in developing and implementing environmental programs or initiatives.
Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to collect, interpret, and report environmental data and performance metrics.
Candidates should possess Environmental Compliance and Environmental Law knowledge to support adherence to federal, state, and local regulations.
Candidates should possess Environmental Science expertise, including familiarity with impact assessments, sustainability principles, and ecological considerations.
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related field; advanced degree is beneficial.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal form.
Experience with environmental impact assessments, permitting processes, and regulatory reporting is an advantage.
Proficiency with environmental data analysis tools, geographic information systems (GIS), or related software is beneficial.
